::: {#exr-09-interview-questions-broken-or-repaired-interactive}
## Interview questions: broken or repaired?, interactive

Sort the questions. Then press **Check**.

```{=html}
<div class="grc-ex" data-type="sort">
<script type="application/json">
{
 "buckets": [
  {
   "id": "broken",
   "label": "Broken"
  },
  {
   "id": "rep",
   "label": "Repaired"
  }
 ],
 "chips": [
  {
   "t": "Don't you find security policies annoying?",
   "b": "broken"
  },
  {
   "t": "How do the security policies affect your daily work?",
   "b": "rep"
  },
  {
   "t": "Do you follow the password policy? (yes/no)",
   "b": "broken"
  },
  {
   "t": "Tell me about the last time the password policy got in your way.",
   "b": "rep"
  },
  {
   "t": "Why is your team bad at reviews?",
   "b": "broken"
  },
  {
   "t": "How do reviews typically go in your team?",
   "b": "rep"
  }
 ],
 "explain": "Repaired questions are open, neutral and anchored in a concrete episode rather than an opinion.",
 "ref": "sec-09-interviews",
 "reflabel": "Interviews"
}
</script>
</div>
```
:::

## Field notes: descriptive or interpretive?, interactive

Sort each note to its column. Then press **Check**.

```{=html}
<div class="grc-ex" data-type="sort">
<script type="application/json">
{
 "buckets": [
  {
   "id": "desc",
   "label": "Descriptive",
   "desc": "what happened"
  },
  {
   "id": "interp",
   "label": "Interpretive",
   "desc": "what I make of it"
  }
 ],
 "chips": [
  {
   "t": "10:14 — build fails on security scan; A adds an ignore flag without opening the finding",
   "b": "desc"
  },
  {
   "t": "suppression is routinised — no discussion needed",
   "b": "interp"
  },
  {
   "t": "B asks A \"real one?\"; A shrugs: \"same as always\"",
   "b": "desc"
  },
  {
   "t": "a shared classification exists that no document defines",
   "b": "interp"
  }
 ],
 "explain": "Keep what happened and what you make of it in separate columns, so that the interpretation can be checked against the record.",
 "ref": "sec-09-observations-and-documents",
 "reflabel": "Observations and documents"
}
</script>
</div>
```
